children: Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh said Wednesday that gauging how restrictive monetary policy is was not easy to do.

“I found it difficult to describe financial conditions as restrictive” and, “what I heard around the table... My colleagues were hard-pressed to describe it that way too,” Warsh said in a press conference following the Fed meeting. But he added in terms of Wednesday's rate hike, “we removed a dose of accommodation, so that financial and credit conditions would be more consistent with our ultimate objectives.”
